sources.title: Identifying conspiracy theories
sources.author: European Commission / UNESCO educational collaboration; pandemic-era resource
sources.sections: General mechanism, own-belief and response sections: scapegoating, closed evidence loops, checking and avoiding ridicule
sources.supported_use: Separate a checkable claim from manipulative rhetoric; allow correction even for a preferred conclusion.
sources.limits: Pandemic-specific claims and examples are not adopted as current facts. Credential or tone heuristics are not truth tests. No linked handbook, campaign diagnosis or efficacy validation.

sources.title: What mediation is and how it can help — Mediation at work
sources.author: Acas; updated October 18, 2022
sources.sections: Opening explanation of an impartial mediator, voluntary participation and control over agreement
sources.supported_use: Distinguish assisted agreement from an imposed decision.
sources.limits: Workplace context. Confidentiality, legal effect and suitability statements are not universal civic or jurisdictional rules. Not a protest, strike or restorative-process operating manual. UN Peacemaker and DPPA pages could not be retrieved and are not claimed inspected.

sources.title: Letter from Birmingham Jail
sources.author: The Martin Luther King, Jr. Research and Education Institute, Stanford University; historical entry about April 16, 1963
sources.type: first-party archival teaching entry with historical excerpts
sources.sections: Entry body on the Birmingham context, facts/negotiation/direct action and challenge to unjust restrictions
sources.supported_use: Historical context for reasoning about conscience, justice and imposed restrictions.
sources.limits: Institutional entry and excerpts only, not the full letter, cited books or a complete philosophical/legal theory. No present legal permission, required faith or equivalence between Cedar and the historical struggle.

sources.title: Community Engagement and Accountability
sources.author: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
sources.sections: Landing-page introduction and commitments to participation, communication and feedback
sources.supported_use: Assistance should be shaped with community members and respond to their feedback.
sources.limits: No linked guide/toolkit reviewed and no program-effect claim evaluated. Does not qualify an informal helper for childcare, food handling, transport, emergency or clinical work.

sources.title: The ILO Social Protection Floors Recommendation, 2012 (No. 202)
sources.author: International Labour Organization; August 12, 2012
sources.sections: Objectives, principles and nationally defined basic guarantees
sources.supported_use: Consider adequacy, dignity, inclusion and financial sustainability in social protection.
sources.limits: Successfully inspected overview only; the full NORMLEX instrument could not be retrieved. Not current local eligibility, tax, appeal or actuarial advice. The toy pool is original, not an ILO financial model.

sources.title: What Is Transitional Justice?
sources.author: International Center for Transitional Justice
sources.sections: Main explanation of affected-person rights, judicial/nonjudicial measures, reparations, institutions and no single formula
sources.supported_use: Compare distinct mechanisms with participation, accountability and dignity.
sources.limits: Overview only, not a live post-conflict design, judicial finding, testimony permission or validated reconciliation outcome. No linked country report or video is claimed inspected.

sources.title: Decent work and the 2030 Agenda for sustainable development
sources.author: International Labour Organization
sources.sections: What is Decent Work? section on productive work, income, security, development, voice and equal treatment
sources.supported_use: Consider work conditions and opportunity beyond prestige.
sources.limits: Conceptual framework, not an eight-axis psychometric instrument, job offer, contract interpretation or career/earnings forecast. No employment statistics or linked video imported.

sources.title: What is Career Readiness? — Professionalism
sources.author: National Association of Colleges and Employers
sources.sections: Professionalism definition and sample behaviors: preparation, dependability, task completion, detail and accountability
sources.supported_use: Connect reliable work habits to specific commitments and useful handoffs.
sources.limits: Only the relevant section used, not the assessment tool or validation evidence. Personal branding is not used as a quality or worth measure. No employment-law rule or promise of limitless availability.

sources.title: Learning Principles
sources.author: Eberly Center, Carnegie Mellon University
sources.sections: Principles 4 and 5 on component skill, integration, appropriate challenge and targeted criterion-based feedback
sources.supported_use: Practice a weakness and check reintegration against a fixed meaningful criterion.
sources.limits: Linked research was not inspected; no precise dose, universal expertise claim or validity of the invented borrowing test. Supplied critique is not actual expert feedback.

sources.title: Quality Glossary
sources.author: American Society for Quality
sources.sections: Quality and QA/QC entries, including needs, deficiencies and fitness for use
sources.supported_use: Assess an artifact by intended use and requirements rather than appearance alone.
sources.limits: Selected entries only, not the entire glossary, a certification standard or actual-room approval. No claimed conformance with an ISO or safety standard.

sources.title: Learning about users and their needs
sources.author: GOV.UK Service Manual; published April 4, 2016; updated March 23, 2017
sources.sections: Validating user needs and linking needs to stories/acceptance; relevant user-language discussion
sources.supported_use: Ground needs in evidence and the user problem, then refine the requirement.
sources.limits: Selected sections, not the whole Service Standard, actual user research or universal accessibility validation. No confidential research data or source examples copied.

sources.title: 6.3 Interface Management
sources.author: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook web edition
sources.sections: Section6.3.1 inputs, responsibilities, controlled interface changes, integration and outputs
sources.supported_use: Make interface inputs, ownership, readiness and change decisions explicit.
sources.limits: Selected interface-management section only; no linked expanded guidance or full handbook review. The small notice card is an original analogy, not a NASA-compliant control or qualified engineering system.
